reviewType: Author translation and semantic/calculation audit against canonical answer meanings plus private extracted source text. Not an independent visual PDF audit.
optionIdentity: Topic order, question IDs and all four original source option slots preserved; locale contains no answer keys. Runtime shuffle identity must be validated by parent.
structuralChecks: Exactly four translated options per question
No answer/answerIndex/correct fields in question locale
All referenced physical PDF pages exist in private extracted text
Numeric-only options match canonical source slots after whitespace normalization
All 192 correct-source-option English/VI pairs inspected after generation

findings.issue: The free-byte example implicitly assumes usable contiguous space or compaction is available. Main l6-1 states this, but quiz prompt only says no additional overhead.
findings.recommendation: Optionally clarify the canonical prompt in both languages so total free bytes are not interpreted as sufficient contiguous bytes in every implementation.
findings.translationStatus: Canonical meaning retained; not a translated-answer defect.

findings.issue: Leaf links identify a neighbour, but adjacent leaves can have different parents; textbook redistribution needs adjacent sibling with the same parent. Main l9-3 correctly explains this distinction.
findings.recommendation: Clarify canonical prompt/explanation if necessary to avoid treating every linked neighbouring leaf as an eligible repair sibling.

findings.issue: Tail latency is an explanatory inference from slide physical page 10 nonuniform/unpredictable chain costs, not a term visibly present in extracted slide text.
findings.recommendation: Keep identified as original supplementary reasoning.
